briefing.whatsNext: The immediate commercial milestone will be the post-win sales surge and print run expansions for The End of Everything across international markets. Whether this victory permanently alters publishing house acquisition strategies to favor sci-fi contenders in major literary prizes depends on sustained critical momentum and sales figures.
